notes.purpose: The task's home: pick the next sow in one unit, read the unit's litter size and the whole task's progress, and jump by pen, ear tag or search.
states: Empty list: "No awaiting sows" / "No matching sows" with a hint ("Adjust the filters…" when a filter is on, else "Choose another status…")
Task already ended: the room is replaced by the Today card "Task ended · N finished / View receipt"
Unit switched from the Task overview: scroll position and current pen are kept per unit, and reset when the lens or filter changed meanwhile

elements.name: Sow row
elements.shows: One row per task sow, grouped under her pen (owner-approved 2026-10-12): the ear tag over 13px muted context on the left, the figure over the state word on the right, weighted by level (act now red with the one "!" icon, live bold, coming up ink, settled muted), one chevron. The same row in Scan results (the context leads with the pen, and says only "Unit 6 · Pen A2" for a sow in another unit); Find a sow's rows use the same Row with her place on the right instead of her state. It is the design system's Row, animal variant.

states.when: No live total (alive + dead = 0), not finished, no outcome; due tomorrow or later
states.shows: Neutral tile "1 / day left" or "5 / days left". Facts "Parity 5 · 11 born last".

states.when: Due today
states.shows: Neutral tile "Today / due". Facts as above.

states.when: Due yesterday or Overdue (expected date = service + 114 days)
states.shows: Red tile "3 / days late" (work for the worker). Facts as above.

states.when: Live total above zero and not finished
states.shows: Neutral tile "9 / alive". Facts "Farrowing · 5 dead · 1h ago · G.H": dead only above zero, never "born N".

states.when: Litter finished (locked)
states.shows: Green tile with a tick, "done". Facts "11 alive · 2 dead · 05:58 · G.H". No pencil: the row opens the record, and Edit is inside it.

states.when: She died and none of her live piglets is hand-reared, placed elsewhere, in a rearing pen or recorded dead
states.shows: Red tile "7 / to allocate". Facts "Sow died" (red) · "yesterday · L.M". Tapping opens the allocation sheet. Owner decision 2026-10-10.

states.when: Her piglets were kept hand-reared on her record
states.shows: Neutral tile "2 / hand-reared"; facts "Sow died · 09:40 · L.M". The row stays while hand-reared piglets remain; a partial allocation keeps the remaining count (never "5 moved"). Tapping opens her record. Owner decision 2026-10-10.

states.when: An abortion with a live piglet
states.shows: Neutral tile "1 / alive" (recorded counts only); facts "Aborted · 08:10 · G.H". With no live piglet she is not listed. Owner decision 2026-10-10.

states.when: Not in pig or Removed from batch recorded
states.shows: Neutral tile with a dash and the outcome word; facts "Not in pig · 08:10 · G.H". Opens the Production log. Counts under Done.

states.when: Sow died with nothing left to allocate or hand-rear; or aborted with no live piglet
states.shows: Not drawn in any lens, Find a sow or Pen map. The Task overview counts her once, under "Left the task". Owner decision 2026-10-10.

elements.logic: Tile colour is meaning only: red solid (white text) is work for the worker (to allocate, days late), green wash is done, neutral is everything else; no border or shadow, the whole row is the tap target. The ID is shown exactly as stored (never grouped, truncated or styled by part; it wraps and the row grows). Only recorded counts show; never "born N" when alive and dead are shown, never an expected or carried count. Pens stay as dividers in aisle order. One function draws the row (sowRow).
elements.source: farrowing-astra-concept.js sowRow(), leftTask(); Row layout need; PRD Decisions 2026-10-10

elements.name: Unit card
elements.shows: The left half of the context strip: unit name, one large figure, its label and a target line.

states.when: The figure is below the target (the card's belowTarget flag)
states.shows: "Target 12" in amber text

states.when: The figure meets or beats the target
states.shows: "Target 12" in the normal support colour

elements.rule: Confirmed by the owner: Target is an amber below-target warning. It is amber when the unit's live-per-litter is below the target and neutral otherwise.
elements.logic: Figure = the unit's average live piglets per litter ("Live / litter"); target = its per-litter target. Not editable; the unit changes only through the Task overview or Home's Choose unit.

elements.name: Task overview card
elements.shows: The right half of the strip, one button that opens the Task overview: heading, number, label, three-colour bar, support line.

states.when: Always
states.shows: "8 / 19 · Done · all units" over a stacked bar

states.when: Done, Active or Awaiting is 0
states.shows: That segment is left out of the bar; the number and support text still print the zero

states.when: Sows aborted with no live piglet, or died with nothing left to allocate
states.shows: Out of the number and the denominator, so the figure still adds up (7 / 18 once one of 19 has left). The overview counts them under Left the task.

elements.logic: Done = every sow still on the list with a finished record, in all units: finished litters, sow deaths and abortions that still have piglets, not in pig, removed. Denominator = every sow still on the list (Done + Active + Awaiting). Sows that left the list are counted on the Task overview as Left the task, and on End task and the receipt as Sow deaths and Aborted, so every sow is in exactly one place.

elements.name: Last record line
elements.shows: "Last record 08:41 · G.H" under the app bar.
elements.logic: Meant to be the newest record time and hand in the unit. In the prototype it is fixed text: 08:41, or 09:41 once any sow carries the 09:41 stamp a live tap writes; the hand is always G.H.

elements.name: State tabs
elements.shows: Awaiting · Active · Done · All, each with a count; All is the default.

states.when: Default
states.shows: Counts for the whole current unit, e.g. Awaiting 4 · Active 1 · Done 2 · All 7

states.when: Due or parity filter is on
states.shows: Every count shrinks to the filtered sows

states.when: A lens has no sows
states.shows: Tab stays, shows 0; the list shows the empty state

elements.logic: Counts are for the current unit only (not all units) and follow the filter, not the other tab. Done = finished litters, sows that died and sows with a recorded outcome. Selecting a tab resets the scroll to the top.

elements.name: Filter
elements.shows: Funnel button beside the tabs; opens the Filter sows sheet (due range, parity).

states.when: Due range 7+ days ago … in 7+ days and parity Any
states.shows: Plain funnel, no summary line

states.when: Due range or parity changed
states.shows: Count badge on the funnel (0–2 filters) and a line under the tabs "Due: Today – In 2 days · Parity 2–5" with Clear

elements.rule: Apply keeps the filter until Clear; Clear removes both filters at once. The due range matches each sow's stored due text, so it also hides Active and Done sows by a date that no longer matters to them.

elements.name: Pen header
elements.shows: Pen code, sow count, chevron (opens the pen page, Inspection's), and "N shown" when rows are hidden.

states.when: Lens All and no filter, or every sow in the pen passes
states.shows: "B4 · 3 sows" ("1 sow" for one)

states.when: The lens or filter hides some of the pen's sows
states.shows: Count unchanged plus "2 shown" beside it

states.when: No sow of the pen passes
states.shows: Pen is not listed at all

elements.logic: The sow count is the pen's full task total, ignoring lens and filter. Pens are ordered alphanumerically.

elements.name: Dock
elements.shows: Pen map (left, framed), Scan ear tag (primary), Search (icon only).

states.when: Each A–D × 1–6 pen in the Pen map sheet
states.shows: One-word fact: "Active" / "2 active"; else "Overdue" / "2 overdue"; else "N born" when all finished; else "Due today" or the due text without "Due" ("Tomorrow", "In 2 days"); "No match" (the pen has sows, none pass the view, disabled); "No sows" (not in the task, disabled). One line, never wraps. A disabled tile stays readable: ink name, muted word, quiet surface.

elements.rule: Pen map: tap goes to the pen, the list already placed under the sheet as it slides away (180ms), and the pen's header takes the tapped tile's colour (a white tile: a 2px ink ring), held 0.9 s and faded by 1.6 s; hold 0.35 s peeks at its sows. The tab bar and filter line stay stuck at the top while the list scrolls. Scan ear tag opens Scan ear tags, a full page where the reader is always listening; the Search icon opens Find a sow, a full page that searches every unit.
elements.source: farrowing-astra-concept.js room() dock, penFact(), roomAfterRender(), scroll handler

A visit entered: see Counting · not saved yet (farrowing.count-draft)

elements.name: Alive card
elements.shows: "Alive", Details › top right, alive now as a 64px figure; under a divider the last save as a run (when · who, its results as quiet chips).
elements.logic: Alive now = saved Alive + Born alive drafted − died after birth drafted. Born dead never lowers it. The card keeps one height in every state, so the drawer never jumps.

elements.name: Keys
elements.shows: One row under the card: a narrow −, a wide green + Born alive, and a compact Death key (the down arrow over the word).
elements.logic: + adds one born alive to the draft; − takes back a + not yet saved and greys at 0 (a saved visit is fixed by undoing it, farrowing.count-saved); Death opens Report death. The drawer is sized to its content and is one height with or without a visit.

elements.name: Bar
elements.shows: Back · Finish farrowing · ··· (the sow's actions).
elements.logic: Finish farrowing is disabled while Born is 0 and is only offered with no draft. ··· opens her actions.

controls.does: change this visit's draft; Save commits it
opens Report death

edge: Closing the drawer keeps the draft on the phone; reopening her finds it
rules: "Born = Alive + Σ Dead … Derived, never entered" (Model)
A visit is a draft until Save; died after birth lowers Alive, born dead does not (owner, 2026-10-23)

notes.purpose: The same drawer with a visit entered and not saved: what this visit changes, and Save.

elements.name: Alive card
elements.shows: "Alive · Not saved yet" in amber; the figure is alive after Save; at its right one chip per kind of change: +3 born, −1 died, 1 born dead.
elements.logic: Chips: born (sage, the farrow icon), died (red, trend-down), born dead (grey, minus); a kind with nothing entered is left out.

elements.name: Clear
elements.shows: Top right of the header, only while something is entered.
elements.logic: Empties the visit's draft (births, deaths, photos).

elements.name: Save
elements.shows: Back · Save in the bar.
elements.logic: Save adds the births to Alive, takes died after birth off it, adds every death to Dead, and writes one log line ("+3 born alive · 1 stillborn · 1 crushed"). The card then reads ✓ Saved.

edge: Back closes the drawer and keeps the draft

notes.purpose: Right after a Save: the Alive card names the last save, and the worker who saved it can undo it to fix a fat finger (owner, 2026-11-02: no Edit record).
states: Saved by this worker and still the last save on her: the run ends in a quiet Undo
Saved by someone else, or anything saved since: the same run with no Undo (as Counting, "Saved Aug 26 08:20 · L.M")
A visit entered: the run hides; the chips are the visit (farrowing.count-draft)

elements.name: Last save
elements.shows: Under a divider in the Alive card: "Saved 09:41 · G.H" (the day too when it is not today), then that save's results on one line as quiet chips: +3 born, −1 died, 1 born dead.
elements.logic: The newest saved visit or Record dead on her. A kind with nothing is left out; at most three chips, which fit one line at 390.

elements.name: Undo
elements.shows: A quiet text action (the return glyph and the word, no box) at the right, centred on the run, the weight of Details ›.
elements.logic: Only the last save on her, only for the worker who saved it, gone once anything else is saved or she is finished. A sibling of the card's door, never inside it.

controls.does: asks Undo the 09:41 save? (farrowing.undo)
opens Litter details

edge: Saved again unchanged after Undo: the line as it was, not Corrected
rules: No Edit record: what is saved is in; the last save can be undone by whoever saved it (owner, 2026-11-02)

notes.purpose: One short question before a save is taken back.
states: Over the counting drawer; after Finish the same question over the finished record (a Record dead)

elements.name: Question
elements.shows: The shared dialog: "Undo the 09:41 save?" and Back · Undo. Nothing else.
elements.logic: Undo takes the save off the record and brings it back as the unsaved draft, exactly as it was (born chip, deaths with their causes, photos); after Finish it reopens Record dead. Back changes nothing.

controls.does: the save comes back unsaved (farrowing.count-draft)
closes the question

edge: Clear after Undo withdraws the save; the log keeps it as Withdrawn
Saved again after a change: one log line marked Corrected, with Was +3 born alive

elements.name: What died
elements.shows: TaskChoice, three tiles: Born dead · Died after birth · The sow (not offered once she has died).

elements.name: Causes

elements.name: Litter

elements.name: Doors

notes.purpose: Report weak and deformed piglets, answer Assisted, add the litter weight if known, then hold to finish and lock Born.

elements.name: Piglet condition
elements.shows: The section heading "Piglet condition" over one flat list: Weak and Deformed steppers, then Assisted and Litter weight in the same right column.
elements.rule: Each tap saves at once. Weak + deformed cannot exceed Alive (the + greys out). Healthy has no row; it is Alive − weak − deformed and prints on the record.

elements.name: Assisted and Litter weight
elements.shows: Two more rows of the same list: Assisted as two square keys No | Yes (No chosen, the chosen key has a 2px ink ring), and Litter weight with a muted "Optional" beside its label and a kg box that shows a dash until a weight is typed.

states.when: Nothing touched

states.when: The kg field tapped
states.shows: The phone's decimal keyboard opens; the field takes an ink ring and a caret; Done closes the keyboard and keeps the value

states.when: Yes tapped, weight typed
states.shows: Yes ringed; the weight in mono with kg

elements.logic: Assisted is required (No preselected; no Clear). Litter weight is optional, one decimal, typed on the Numpad (no system keyboard); empty or 0 is not recorded. No range warning in the prototype (the ruled soft warning outside 0.8–2.5 kg × alive is absent).

elements.name: Save note
elements.shows: Primary action, disabled while the field is empty.
elements.rule: A sow keeps one note: Save replaces it and writes "Note updated · text" to her history, so the previous text is only in the log. Closed once the sow has died ("This sow has died.").

edge: Back returns to More actions and keeps the draft on the device.

notes.purpose: Work through the litter's processing items day by day and tick what was done.

elements.name: Care items
elements.shows: A summary ("2 of 5 care items done"), then a card per day with its items.

states.when: A day before the sample day
states.shows: Day 1 "Recorded"; items ticked with who and when

states.when: Day 3
states.shows: Open circles, meta "Due today" (Iron supplement, Ear tag, notch and weight)

states.when: Later days
states.shows: "In 2 days" (Day 5, Health check)

elements.logic: The day labels are computed against a fixed sample "today = day 3". Ticking an item sets its meta to "This visit · G.H"; un-ticking restores "Due today" or "In 2 days".
elements.rule: Nothing is saved on a tick: "Save care updates" is disabled until something changes and writes one history entry, "Piglet processing updated · n of 5 items done". Due items stay visible until the litter is saved.

edge: Opens only when a litter has been recorded; otherwise the action is closed with "Record the litter first."
issues: A second design of piglet processing: the Piglet processing task feature has its own (see the decision "Piglet processing is drawn in Farrowing and as its own feature").

notes.purpose: Give one piglet its identity, or edit one: ear tag, ear notch, sex and weight.
states: Add piglet identity: "New identity" card, empty fields.
Piglet identity: the same form filled from a piglet row.

elements.name: Save identity
elements.shows: Primary action, disabled while all four fields are empty.
elements.rule: Enabled as soon as any one of tag, notch, sex or weight has a value. A new identity moves one piglet from "Without identity" to "Identified" and writes "Piglet identity added · tag" to the sow's history; the list then shows the Piglet records tab.
elements.logic: Scan tag and Ear notch on the Piglet records tab open this form pre-filled with a sample tag (418001 plus the number identified) or a "Choose notch" placeholder.

edge: Dead piglets stay in the list but cannot be selected.
issues: Save accepts sex or weight alone, so a row can be saved with neither tag nor notch; RULINGS (Piglet processing, Q3) says tag or notch identifies and sex and weight are optional.

notes.purpose: Record piglet deaths in one pass: the identified piglets ticked on the Piglet records tab, plus any without identity.

elements.name: Unidentified piglets
elements.shows: A stepper, shown only while the litter has piglets without identity.
elements.logic: Maximum = the smaller of piglets without identity and alive piglets minus those already ticked. Total to report = ticked piglets + this stepper.

elements.name: Cause
elements.shows: A picker: Cause unknown, Crushed, Scours, Starve-out, Other.
elements.logic: One cause applies to the whole save ("Use another pass when the causes differ"). The litter's counters have six types: Cause unknown is counted under Other, and Stillborn and Mummified are not offered here.

elements.name: Save mortality
elements.shows: Primary action, "Save mortality · 3".
elements.rule: Disabled until a cause is chosen and the total is above zero. Saving marks the ticked piglets Dead, lowers Alive by the total, adds the total to that cause's dead counter, never lowers Born, and writes "N piglets died · cause" (with any photos) to the history.

edge: Reachable with nothing ticked when the litter has piglets without identity ("0 identified selected"); Save stays disabled until the stepper or a tick gives a total.
issues: A third place to record piglet deaths in the same prototype: the sow's Record dead drawer (staged, with Stillborn and Mummified), the Record piglet deaths row on More actions, and this form. RULINGS says "ONE dead drawer product-wide".
